# Akiya Check

> English risk reports for foreign buyers of akiya and cheap houses in Japan. Paste a Japanese property listing URL and get a report within 24 hours covering rebuild restrictions (saikenchiku-fuka), flood and landslide hazard zones, septic (jokaso) and propane, leasehold (shakuchiken), akiya-bank conditions, and the exact questions to ask the agent. $49 per property / $99 for three. Operated by the Akiya Check editorial team. Last updated: 2026-11-23.
